title: Album release: Extended Versions by Ringo Starr | 2003
content:
Extended Versions, the sixth live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 1 April 2003.

It was recorded by the former Beatles drummer and the All-Starr Band at the Rosemont Theatre in Rosemont, Illinois, on 22 August 2001. It was the 20th show by the seventh All-Starr Band, whose tour of North America lasted for 28 dates between July and September 2001.

Several of the songs from the show had previously been released on the album King Biscuit Flower Hour Presents Ringo & His New All-Starr Band. The recordings of ‘Yellow Submarine’, ‘Act Naturally’, ‘Photograph’, ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’, and ‘Glamorous Life’ appear on both releases.

Extended Versions was released one week after Starr’s album Ringo Rama. It did not chart.
